info.description: Cookie-authenticated, mobile-only group game. Legacy three-round duels remain in show-openapi-v1.json. No device, BLE, camera or actuator authority. Paid YOLO work starts only after both participants accept; combat scoring never calls AI.

get.summary: Read current approved artwork for an opponent in an owned team match
get.description: Requires an eligible same-group match participant and a canonical opposing user ID. Revalidates the current character, selected generated wand, publication approval and SHA revision on every read. Returns only the canonical PNG with Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

200.description: Approved canonical PNG

404.description: Match, opposing participant, current publication or revision unavailable

tacticalUnlocked.description: True only when both the 30 XP and tier-two wand requirements are met.

opponentWands.description: Current approved artwork for opposing participants only, keyed by canonical opponent user ID. Hydrated on specific match and mutation responses; omitted or null in the lobby.
